title: Substantive participles
subtitle: Read “the one who …” as a noun phrase.
overview: The article plus participle often makes a noun phrase: ὁ πιστεύων, “the one who believes.”
Parse the participle for voice and agreement; then ask what role the whole article–participle phrase plays.

items.grc: ὁ πιστεύων εἰς τὸν υἱὸν ἔχει ζωὴν αἰώνιον.
items.en: The one who believes in the Son has eternal life.
